title: BiomeManifest
description: Declares the rules and configurations provided by a Biome package.

$schema.description: An optional JSON Schema reference used by editors.

configs.description: Named configurations and selected configurations from other packages.

plugins.description: Named plugin rules and presets provided by the package.

ManifestEntry.description: A selected package export or a map from public names to package-relative files.

anyOf.description: A named export selected from an installed package.
Public names mapped to package-relative files.

ManifestPlugins.description: Named lint rules and groups of rules provided by a Biome package.

presets.description: Named groups of rules that can be loaded together.

rules.description: Named rules and selected rules or presets from other packages.
